an5.77:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcimāni bhikkhave anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:2.2: idha bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.77:2.4: ekakaṃ kho pana maṃ araññe viharantaṃ
an5.77:2.5: ahi vā ḍaṃseyya, vicchiko vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, satapadī vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya.
an5.77:2.6: tena me assa kālakiriyā so mamassa antarāyo.
an5.77:2.7: handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
an5.77:2.8: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.77:3.4: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā me bhuttaṃ vyāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ,
an5.77:3.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā so mamassa antarāyo.
an5.77:3.6: handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā” ti.
an5.77:3.7: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.77:4.4: vālehi vā samāgaccheyyaṃ, sīhena vā vyagghena vā dīpinā vā acchena vā taracchena vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:4.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā. so mamassa antarāyo.
an5.77:4.6: handā’haṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
an5.77:4.7: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.77:5.4: māṇavehi samāgaccheyyaṃ katakammehi vā akatakammehi vā. te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ.
an5.77:5.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā so mamassa antarāyo.
an5.77:5.6: handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.”
an5.77:5.7: idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.77:6.3: santi kho pana araññe vālā amanussā. te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ.
an5.77:6.4: tena me assa kālakiriyā. so mamassa antarāyo.
an5.77:6.5: handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
an5.77:6.6: idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:7.1: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
